from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyPayableRecord(BaseModel):
    """A specific 'Accounts Payable' line item found in a company's financial report."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The name of the company filing the report")
    line_item_label: str | None = Field(description="The exact label of the line item containing the payable value")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The numeric value of the payable as written in the report")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount: e.g. 'thousands', 'millions', 'dollars', 'actual dollars'")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The date the financial report covers (e.g. 'March 31, 2024')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_payables: list[CompanyPayableRecord]
